authorization_evaluation_epoch.rule: One authorize call captures decision_time once, allocates one service-local evaluation_epoch_id, begins one SQLite Deferred transaction on the service-owned connection before the first trusted read, performs every trusted-input and authorization-state read, join, command construction, and kernel evaluation through that transaction, fixes one binary decision, and ends the transaction only afterward.
authorization_evaluation_epoch.retry_rule: A retry must recapture time, allocate a new usable service-local epoch identity, begin a new transaction, and reread every input.
authorization_evaluation_epoch.proof_limit: The correlation id is not epoch proof. Proof requires observed use of one connection and transaction capability for every selected read plus the exact joins above.

fail_closed_rule.allow_iff: all exact cardinality, trust, currentness, expiry, enablement, completeness, identity, field, revision, scope-evidence, role-grant, permission, transaction, and kernel predicates hold inside one evaluation epoch
deny_on: untrusted revoked or expired authentication evidence
empty or invalid converted identity or revision

missing duplicate untrusted or mismatched scope evidence
missing or mismatched exact role permission
clock provider query transaction or commit failure
